combo.description: To knock up a distant enemy E Q instantly and before you complete it Flash onto your target.
For a close range burst Q and instantly Flash, then E R as quickly as you can followed by an AA.
To escape or trap an enemy R and E Q out once you land.
From long range, E Q instantly then right before you hit your flag Flash and R.
To get on top of an enemy Flash then instantly R. AA once you land then instantly E Q followed by more AA's.
To trap an enemy whilst you are low E Q instantly then W R as soon as you are in range. Flash out instantly after R.
When out of range for R, E Q to get into range and R while still mid air. Follow up with an AA.
When looking to gank before 6 E Q instantly then AA once you arrive. Use W right as or after they land then AA.
When looking to gank after 6 E Q instantly then AA followed by R AA
For a quick combo Q E R one after another as quickly as you can, then AA.
